title: Reduced-belt transient mechanics: phase-aware broad and controlled exploration
scientific_question: Which surviving transient terms in CINDER's final reduced-belt equations are active, what physical conditions activate them, and which coherent approximation classes merit later trajectory-level testing?
decision_gate: No belt reduction is introduced until phase-aware and controlled-load results distinguish persistent, event-only, driver-limited, coefficient-limited, and structurally dynamic terms.
